text:
sam_h: FYI customer (MistralRetail) just asked us to onboard hf/borealis-11b. They want Private/Dedicated deployment due to PII, int8 quant experiments, and target p95 latency <150ms with <=5% quality regression vs their baseline. Can we triage?

nora_ml: @sam_h putting this in intake. Do we have the package (weights + tokenizer) and an eval set? Any custom ops?

sam_h: They uploaded torch weights + standard tokenizer to s3 (link in ticket). No custom ops reported. Eval set is ~2k customer prompts but contains PII so must run in VPC. Customer prefers q8_dynamic and a q4 fallback for cost.

jasper_quant: I can take quant smoke. Plan: q8_dynamic, q4f16, q4_sequential. Need the baseline outputs (gold) and the customer metric (intent accuracy). Also need a small 500 prompt smoke set to start.

devon_infra: Capacity notes: for p95 <150ms with batch=1 we'll likely need A100-sxm 80GB or similar; recommend 2 replicas for canary. For Private we need onboarding checklist (KMS, network peering). Cold-starts may hit 1s+ due to KV build.

ops-bot: New ticket created: ML-3421. Linked artifacts: s3://private/mistral-retail/borealis-11b. CI job queued: quant-smoke-2113456789.

nora_ml: Proposed triage checklist (short):
  1) Validate checksum + model graph load
  2) Run baseline (fp16) accuracy on 500 prompts -> store baselines
  3) Run quant candidates (q8_dynamic, q4f16, q4_sequential) perf + quality
  4) Run regression suite (500->2000 prompts) compare metrics (intent acc, f1)
  5) Define acceptance gates and canary rollout policy
  6) Security/privacy signoff for Private deploy

sam_h: Acceptance thresholds from customer: intent accuracy drop <=5% vs baseline. Also want to cap hallucination increase (we'll use their hallucination heuristics). If >5% we hold.

jasper_quant: Starting with this command locally: 
```bash
python -m quant.run \\  --model s3://private/mistral-retail/borealis-11b \\  --quant q8_dynamic \\  --batch 1 \\  --warmup 30 \\  --eval-file s3://private/mistral-retail/evals/retail_smoke_500.json
```
Will post perf logs to ML-3421.

devon_infra: Suggested deployment snippet for Dedicated/Private: 
```yaml
deployment:
  mode: private
  instance: a100-sxm-80gb
  replicas: 2
  autoscale:
    min: 1
    max: 4
  batch_size: 1
  kv_cache_warmup: true
  fallback_policy:
    fallback_model: raptor-12b-lite
    traffic: 0
```

sam_h: ETA expectations? Jasper, how long for smoke + perf?

jasper_quant: Rough: quant smoke + perf numbers ~8-12h on 1 pod; full regression suite 24-36h. Canary + monitoring config 1 day. I'll update ML-3421 when q8 run finishes.

nora_ml: I'll own the quality gate. If any metric slips >5% we stop rollout and loop in research. Also we need to run tokenizer linting with customer text (edge cases).

ops-bot: Reminder: least-privilege creds required for S3. See ML-3421 checklist items 2 and 7.

jasper_quant: Quick interim result: q8_dynamic smoke on a100-sxm p95 ~140ms (batch=1) after warmup. Intent acc drop ~3.2% on the 200-sample smoke set. Pushing full smoke logs to ML-3421.

nora_ml: Good start. Next: run q4f16 to see cost/quality tradeoff and run the 2k regression set. Also schedule canary plan: 10% traffic 6h -> 50% 24h if stable.

devon_infra: Note: cold-start measured at ~1.2s for first request (kv cache). Recommend pre-warm job on deploy.

sam_h: Thanks all. I'll tell the customer we have a working q8 smoke with preliminary metrics, ETA for complete regression and canary plan is ~48-72h. Will ping here with any customer constraints. :thumbsup:

(ops-bot): Ticket ML-3421 updated with "q8 smoke results attached" and assigned to jasper_quant, nora_ml, devon_infra.
